purpose: Teach: 熟語/官能/固体/開校/国体/農耕/高分子/感嘆

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の熟語理解度を医療チームで評価します
lines.en: Ren, we assess patient comprehension across the medical team.
lines.style: Measured, professional opening. Clear enunciation on clinical terms. Steady pace, warm but clinical. No rush — the tone of someone used to explaining important things carefully.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、官能評価試験を医療チームで用います
lines.en: Yes, we use sensory evaluation testing as part of our team assessment.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Slightly slower on technical terms. Patient, unhurried — reassuring without being patronizing. She's clarifying, not correcting.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、固体内服薬の処方を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Ren, the medical team manages the dispensing of solid-form medications carefully.
lines.style: Direct, clinical precision. Even tone. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. No inflection toward warmth or distance — just the facts, delivered with care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 看護学校開校時の医療連携を、貴院、おこなわれましたね、先生
lines.en: When the nursing school opened, your hospital coordinated medical services for that transition, didn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Thoughtful, respectful inquiry. Soft start on the question. Slight rise on 'coordinated' — not challenging, but genuinely curious. Acknowledging her expertise. Small pause before 'sensei' — not performative, genuine.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、国体大会時の救護体制を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, during the National Games, the medical team managed emergency response protocols.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Brief, matter-of-fact. She's not elaborating because the point was heard. Professional clarity without distance — she respects that he's asking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 農耕従事者の腰痛対策を、貴院、研究されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital researches lower-back pain prevention for agricultural workers, doesn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity with respect underneath. Slightly slower pace — he's thinking as he speaks. Warm inquiry, not interrogation. The tone of someone asking because he actually wants to know, not to test.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、高分子膜を用いた人工臓器を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Yes, the medical team is researching artificial organs using polymer membranes.
lines.style: Measured affirmation. Slight weight on 'artificial organs' — these are significant words. Even breath, unhurried. The tone of someone sharing something she's proud of, but with professional restraint.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療の成果に患者が感嘆を、貴院、よく受けられますね、先生
lines.en: Patients often express deep gratitude when they see the results of treatment at your hospital, don't they, sensei?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely impressed. Opens softly. Builds slightly toward 'gratitude' — there's real feeling here, carefully controlled. Close observation in the voice — he's noticed something about how this place works. Respectful distance maintained.
